# What if AI could do an engineer’s most tedious work?

We’ve launched the Eigen Engineering Agent, purpose-built AI for industrial automation engineering.
It moves AI beyond generating suggestions to executing engineering tasks end-to-end. Now available
for more than 600,000 TIA Portal users.

[Start free trial][3][How AI transforms Engineering][4]
[CES 2026: Roland Busch & Jensen Huang, Siemens & NVIDIA]

## Building the operating system for Industrial AI

Together with NVIDIA, we are building the Industrial AI operating system for the physical world.
Read the latest news from our ever-expanding partnership here.

[Learn more][5]
[Vectron X Primary - Tec Keyvisual 16to9]

## Vectron X – the next dimension of rail technology

The next generation of locomotives for freight and passenger transport combines the proven platform
technology with app-based functionalities, open interfaces for third-party providers, in an open
ecosystem – connecting people, places and portfolios more closely than ever before.

[Read more][6]
[bx-overview-panoramic-city-skyline-is485896260-xcelerator-shape-hero-2560x1440]

## One digital twin, clear operational insight

At the University of Wollongong, a digital twin brings together data from 1,000 assets, 500 BMS
points, energy meters and documents, to create a single source of truth and enable efficient,

## 01

### siteConnect CS

Sharing operational data using our siteConnect™ Platform provides greater visibility into your HVAC,
BAS, and EMS systems, leading to better control over your equipment. A two-way data flow enables
full access to our analytic software as well as the HVAC equipment from all your locations.

For example, the facility manager can check on the chiller from home first thing in the morning and
the service provider can remotely troubleshoot the system down to the individual components.
Corrective actions can be implemented much faster as the service provider can begin troubleshooting
and ensure technicians are fully aware of the related issue prior to arriving at the site.

# Master Electrician Services Near South Jersey Since 2011

[← Back to all services][14]

Since 2011, DK Electrical Solutions has provided high-quality, affordable electrical repair and
installation services across Burlington County, Camden County, and Mercer County, NJ.

## Locally Owned

We're a locally owned and operated team of Master Electricians based in Pemberton, NJ.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Are your electricians licensed and certified?

Yes. Every electrician at DK Electrical Solutions is fully licensed in New Jersey, and our team
includes Master Electricians who hold the highest level of certification in the field.

Do you offer financing for larger projects?

We do. DK Electrical Solutions offers easy financing options on panel upgrades, generator
installation, whole-home rewiring, and other larger electrical investments.

What areas of South Jersey do you serve?

We serve all of Burlington County, Camden County, and Mercer County, NJ — including Southampton,
Medford, Marlton, Mt. Laurel, Haddonfield, Moorestown, Cherry Hill, Trenton, Hamilton, and
Willingboro.

How does your pricing work?

We provide on-site estimates with upfront, flat-rate pricing — so you'll know exactly what to expect
before any work begins.

## About DK Electrical Solutions

If this services hub resource was useful, the same Master-Electrician-led team behind it handles
real installations and repairs across South Jersey every day. Since 2011 our crews have served
Burlington, Camden, Mercer and Ocean counties under New Jersey Electrical Contractor License #17216
— which means a Master Electrician of record signs off every panel swap, EV charger circuit,
generator hookup, and rewire we complete.

We focus on the work behind the cover plate: torque-marked lugs, neatly labeled panels, code-correct
grounding and bonding, and permits pulled with the local construction office so the inspector signs
the card before we leave. Pricing is flat-rate and itemized in writing — no hourly billing, no
surprise add-ons, and a written workmanship warranty on every installation.

Towns we serve weekly include Willingboro, NJ · Southampton, NJ · Medford, NJ · Marlton, NJ ·
Moorestown, NJ · Mt. Laurel, NJ. If you'd like a real on-site estimate, call (609) 796-4177 or
browse [our full electrical services catalog][37] and [all the South Jersey towns we cover][38]. New
homeowners often start with our [panel upgrade][39], [whole-house generator][40], or [EV charger

# Upcoming Events

[Aputure at BIRTV Beijing]
[BIRTV Beijing][29]
From illuminating light and shadow to defining the future. In 2025, we opened a new chapter in LED
point-source technology for film and television with our proprietary BLAIR and BLAIR-CG light
engines. In 2026, we will launch an update to our light engine technology, delivering optical
solutions that revolutionize performance at the source and eliminate the trade-off between
brightness and color. This year also marks a major upgrade to our intelligent control ecosystem and
the debut of an all-new product line. A spectacular showcase of light and shadow awaits, don't miss
it! We look forward to welcoming you!
8/19/2026
[Aputure at IBC Amsterdam]
[IBC Amsterdam][30]
Discover how Aputure's expanding ecosystem of professional lighting solutions is transforming
broadcast, live production, film, and studio workflows. Rather than showcasing individual products,
our booth demonstrates complete production environments, highlighting the seamless integration of
the STORM and NOVA series with Sidus Link Pro for intelligent, network-based lighting control.
Explore the Sidus Playground to experience advanced lighting workflows firsthand, see real-world
applications throughout the booth, and be among the first to discover exciting new additions to the
Aputure lineup that further expand our professional lighting ecosystem.

## [Lawn Grass Suppliers in Brisbane: Their Transportation and Installation Services][32]

[July 19, 2025June 25, 2025][33]

A lawn grass supplier in Brisbane is likely to comprehend the impact of weather on turf installation
in any location, regardless of whether it is residential or commercial. Choosing appropriate and
quality grass is among the many facets of the process, but it’s not the only important aspect.
Delivery and setup services from lawn grass suppliers significantly influence the quality of the
work. Such treatments could greatly affect the lifetime and overall function of the new grass being
placed. When laying turf in areas known for excessive humidity, weather fluctuations, and extreme
heat, it is very important to consider these elements.

 

## Providing Consistent, Well Run Delivery Services

Most Brisbane lawn suppliers are well-known for their services around the region. Delivery options
differ only according to the type of grass, distance, and order size. From modest yards to big
commercial sites, turf suppliers can handle a wide range of order sizes. Turf suppliers usually
harvest the grass on the same day it is delivered to ensure quality.

 

It is imperative to complete this step, as the grass will begin to degrade rapidly if it is exposed
to the sun or warmer temperatures. Turf suppliers recognise that expedited delivery choices can
shield the grass from drying out or overheating prior to installation. For this reason, most lawn
grass suppliers prefer to deliver the turf early in the morning.

 

Some suppliers will also offer clients same-day or next-day delivery options, which depend on the
availability at the time. Clients who live in more rural areas or hard-to-access parts of the region
may need to plan for delivery ahead of time or pay a delivery surcharge.

 

## Installation Services: Do-It-Yourself or Obtain Professional Assistance?

When it comes to installing turf, clients have a choice to either lay the turf themselves or hire a
professional turf supplier service. If you have landscaping experience, you could likely install the
turf yourself, especially if the site is smaller and less complex. However, turf installation does
require a lot of physical effort, mostly from having to roll out the turf pieces, which can be quite
heavy.

 

It also requires leveling the ground or soil before installing it, which can be strenuous on its
own. Some turf suppliers offer complete installation packages, which include the following:

 
* Application of fertiliser on soil.
* The preparation of the site includes tilling and levelling the soil.
* To ensure complete soil contact, they will roll and compact the turf.
* To ensure the turf fits at the designated site, they will lay and cut it.
* They provide aftercare and watering instructions to ensure longevity.

 

Having turf installed professionally ensures that it will be laid properly and quickly. This reduces
the risk of things such as uneven seams, gaps, and poor establishment of the roots.

 

## Site Positioning and Access

To ensure that delivery trucks can easily offload pallets closer to the installation site, lawn
grass suppliers will ask for clear access to the area. If access to the site is restricted, there
might be a need for additional handling by either the client or added labour services. Some turf
suppliers will provide mechanical forklifts to help with easier placement, especially for heavy
orders.

 

## Final Thoughts

When you decide to work with a [high-quality lawn grass supplier in Brisbane][34], it is important
to ask about schedule flexibility and guidance with installing the turf. Most turf suppliers will

## [Top Swimming Pool Design Trends Gold Coast 2025][35]

[July 16, 2025July 7, 2025][36]

A swimming pool is not just a place to cool your body from the extreme Gold Coast heat, but also a
perfect place where you can relax and unwind after a long and tiresome day or week. Swimming pools
form a great part of outdoor living in many Gold Coast homes, making it necessary to understand the
different types of pools that exist on the Gold Coast to make an informed decision.

Whether you are thinking of building a new pool or renovating the existing one, here are the top
trend designs for swimming pools on the Gold Coast.

## Exceptional swimming pool design trends in Gold COAS

### Smaller and Smarter Pools

Not everyone has space for a large pool. Many homeowners now choose plunge pools or small lap pools.
These pools save space and money as they require very little space and resources to build. They also
work well in city homes or smaller backyards and are highly recommended for homeowners with very
little space in their backyards.

### Natural-looking pools

Today, human activities have greatly transformed the environment, and it is hard to distinguish
between nature and man-made features. Therefore, many people want pools that look like part of
nature in 2025. This means using soft shapes, natural stone, and plants around the pool to achieve a
natural-looking finish. Some even choose a lagoon or rock pool style to blend in with their garden.

### Smart pool technology

Smart pools are becoming very popular on the Gold Coast. You can now control pool lights, heating,
and cleaning systems from your phone wherever you happen to be. Some systems even test water quality
and add chemicals automatically with absolutely no human intervention. This makes pool care easier
and faster.

Electrical4U is dedicated to the teaching and sharing of all things related to electrical and
electronics engineering.

[Band pass filters][96], [Oscillators][97], [Gray Code][98], [Half Wave Rectifiers,][99]

Safety advice

### Keeping your family and home safe

Electricity keeps our homes running—but it can also pose serious risks if not handled properly.
Whether you're boiling the kettle, charging your phone, or rewiring a plug, knowing how to stay safe
is essential. This section offers clear, practical advice for every room and the people in your
home.

[Safety advice for you][41]

### Expert guidance for electrical professionals.

As an electrician, you know the importance of working safely with electricity, but even experienced

## Hager Group, an independent family company shaping tomorrow’s electrical world.

Hager Group is a leading provider of solutions and services for electrical installations in
residential, commercial and industrial buildings. Our range of solutions and services extends from
energy distribution to cable management and from security systems to building automation. As an
independent family-owned and family-run company based in Blieskastel, Germany, we are one of the
industry’s innovation leaders. 13.000 employees generate sales of around 3,0 billion euros (2024).
Our components and solutions are produced at 23 locations around the globe and customers in 100
countries all over the world trust in them. We owe our success to their trust.
[About us][20]

## Hager Annual and Sustainability Report 2025/26

The world around us continues to evolve at an unprecedented pace. Rapid technological advances, the
energy transition, increasing sustainability expectations, and changing customer needs are reshaping
our industry and creating new opportunities for growth. Against this backdrop, our focus remains
clear: to build a resilient business that delivers lasting value while helping our customers
navigate the transformation of the energy landscape. 

This Annual Report reflects the progress we have made over the past year and the strategic direction
that continues to guide our journey. It tells the story of a company that is transforming with
purpose—combining operational excellence, innovation, and sustainability to strengthen our
competitive position and prepare for the future.

[Discover the full online version][21]
[annual_report_1024x1024]

## Our approach to sustainability

We want to shape tomorrow’s electrical world and make people’s life on our planet safer, cleaner and
more enjoyable through our actions and with our products. And, our sustainability policy is just one
of the ways to get there.
[Find out more][22]
[about hager group]

## Our values

Our company founders’ courageous entrepreneurial spirit, authenticity and integrity continue to
shape our future and make us who we are. Our values are at the heart of everything we do and form
the basis of our success.
[Find out more][23]
[hg_our_values]

Raising the bar to the next level, L&T is undertaking big goals related to Climate Change and Water
Security. We aim to achieve Carbon Neutrality by 2040, ahead of the Paris Agreement deadline of
2050, and Water Neutrality by 2035.

Sustainability is embedded in our vision, culture, strategy, and business processes. We are
committed to sustainable growth, and integrate Environment, Social and Governance (ESG) principles
in all aspects of our business.

The answer is it depends.

For long-tail keywords we typically say 3 to 6 weeks. 

For broad SEO keywords it can take anyway from 3 to 6 months to see measurable result.

##### How do you determine my SEO budget?

This is one of the most common questions we get.

Your SEO budget depends on factors like:
* Your business goals
* Keyword competition
* How quickly you want to see results
* Whether you’re targeting broad or long-tail keywords

Who We Are

## Building Relationships

For almost 10 decades, we have focused on providing quality electrical solutions for our clients
while building meaningful careers for our people in an environment that encourages inclusivity,
development and balance. Our company is committed to the continued stewardship of our communities
and our industry as we look to build relationships that power the possibilities of a more connected
future.

[Learn More][52]

What We Do

## Innovative Solutions

Founded in 1928, we have grown from a local electrical contractor to one of the largest in the
industry with almost 5,000 employees. Our company has expanded its services beyond traditional
electrical contracting to include systems integration, connected communities, building automation,
business continuity, and energy & sustainability services. Headquartered in Jacksonville, Florida,
we utilize a network of branch offices and industry partners to provide our clients with innovative
solutions and quality service so that they can remain focused on their core business.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

## Rugged Power, Reliable Connectivity for Off-Highway and Industrial Vehicles

Trusted global manufacturer of wiring harnesses, battery cables and complete electrical systems
engineered for demanding off-highway environments – built on decades of expertise, precision
manufacturing and vertical integration.

[Talk to a solutions expert][8]

## What We Do – Our Solutions

Purpose-built Off-Highway electrical systems

From concept to full production, we provide OEMs and Tier-1 partners with engineered power and
connectivity solutions that perform in harsh environments – vibration, moisture, dust and
temperature extremes.

## Core Capabilities

**Our core capabilities combine robust design, proven manufacturing and end-to-end integration to
support demanding Off-Highway and industrial applications:**
* Ruggedised wiring harnesses and cable assemblies
* Battery and power cable assemblies
* High-voltage power distribution modules
* Custom assemblies and systems integration
* Durable connectors, fuse boxes and busbars
* Prototyping, testing and scalable production

MT | Volex combines proven engineering expertise with the strength of Volex’s global manufacturing
network. Our solutions are designed for reliability, durability and consistent performance in
demanding off-highway environments. With vertically integrated production and rigorous quality
standards, we help customers reduce risk, improve efficiency and accelerate time to market.

Decades of manufacturing know-how and engineering excellence

Vertically integrated production for speed and quality control

Built for harsh off-highway conditions – durability without compromise

Close alignment with global markets and customer needs via Volex networks

OEM and Tier-1 trusted partner

[About Volex Off-Highway Capabilities][15]

## Applications We Serve

Our power and connectivity solutions support a wide range of off-highway and industrial vehicle
platforms operating in harsh conditions. From heavy equipment to specialised machinery, MT | Volex
delivers electrical systems engineered for performance, safety and long-term reliability across
diverse industries and operating environments.

**Agricultural Machinery**

**Construction  Equipment**

**Mining Vehicles**

**Forestry and Utility Equipment**

**

**Lift Trucks**

## Locations

MT | Volex operates within a strategically aligned manufacturing footprint built to support
scalability, consistent quality and responsive supply. Our 6 MT | Volex factories – alongside 2
additional Volex facilities dedicated to the Off-Highway market – are part of Volex’s broader global
network of 23 manufacturing sites.

Our facilities are structured to meet demanding production requirements while maintaining rigorous
quality and operational standards. This manufacturing foundation enables reliable programme
execution, supply continuity and close alignment with customer needs across global markets.

We are your leading partner in smart home and building management solutions in the Middle East,
providing cutting-edge technology and empowering IT businesses to thrive. Our mission is to drive
innovation and growth in this dynamic sector.
[BECOME A PARTNER ][29]
Smart home equipment, training & technical support center in the Middle East


[BECOME A PARTNER ][30]
**Runn Automation LLC** — Smart home equipment, training and technical support center serving system
integration companies, headquartered in Dubai, UAE. Specializing in smart home and building
management systems, Runn offers comprehensive solutions tailored to enhance residential and
commercial properties with advanced automation technology. Our dedicated team expertly handles every
phase of integration, from initial concept design to final installation and ongoing support.
Our manufacturers
We collaborate with world-renowned brands and manufacturers to guarantee superior performance and
quality
Larnitech is known for its innovative solutions in smart home technology. Their products focus on
enhancing comfort and energy efficiency, making modern living more convenient.
Citron specializes in high-quality smart home devices that integrate seamlessly into any
environment. Their user-friendly products prioritize security and automation for a smarter
lifestyle.
CoolAutomation offers advanced solutions for HVAC control in smart homes. Their technology ensures
optimal climate management, providing comfort while reducing energy consumption.
Switches & Thermostats provide intuitive interfaces for controlling smart home systems. With sleek
designs and user-friendly functionality, they enhance the overall user experience in home
automation.
KNX is a leading standard for home and building automation. It enables the interoperability of
various devices, allowing for a fully integrated smart home experience that enhances convenience and
efficiency.
Wireless technology is at the forefront of smart home solutions, offering flexibility and ease of
installation. This brand focuses on providing reliable and secure wireless devices for seamless
connectivity in your home.
[LEARN MORE ABOUT OUR BRANDS ][31]
We deliver end-to-end solutions, including:
* Lighting and dimming control
  
  Light groups, led strips control, easily customizable light scenes
* HVAC control systems
  
  Ensuring efficient and comfortable operation of the entire climate control system
* Motorized curtain & shade systems
  Control of curtains, blinds, shutters, gates, and other motorized devices
* Multimedia & home theater automation
  Integration of audio and video equipment into the multiroom system, media content management
* Security
  Providing all aspects of security, access control and video surveillance
* App and voice control
  Smartphone and tablet control, voice control, scripts, and other features
[SMART HOME CONCEPT ][32]

Our Expertise

Our team comprises professionals with 22 years of Smart home systems experience, certified KNX
Technical specialists, experienced project design engineers.

This experienced workforce ensures precision, reliability, and innovation in every project we
undertake.

Additionally, we provide specialized training and consulting services for installers and
construction developers' personnel, ensuring effective integration and utilization of smart home
technologies.
Why choose us?
As official representatives of Larnitech, we offer more than just equipment sales. We provide
comprehensive support, ensuring your success at every stage. We also cooperate with other brands
that perfectly complement our main equipment.
Official Representation
As the authorized representatives of Larnitech, we deliver an unparalleled level of expertise and
assistance. Our deep understanding of the products and their applications allows us to offer
tailored solutions that meet your specific needs. We are dedicated to building long-term
relationships with our clients, ensuring you receive the best possible service and support.
Support at Every Stage
Our commitment to your success continues well beyond the initial purchase. We provide an extensive
training program designed to equip you with the knowledge and skills necessary to maximize the use
of our equipment. Additionally, we offer on-site inspections to assess your specific requirements,
assistance during installation, and comprehensive post-installation support. Our goal is to ensure
that you are fully satisfied and confident in operating your new equipment.
Reliable Equipment with a 5-Year Warranty
We understand that investing in equipment is a significant decision. That's why we offer reliable
products backed by a 5-year warranty, ensuring your investment is protected. Our equipment is
designed for durability and efficiency, giving you peace of mind knowing that it will perform
reliably for years to come.

The work is performed by full-time design engineers with at least 5 years of experience.

*It’s recommended to have your switchboard inspected every 5-10 years or if you notice frequent

*No. Electrical work should only be performed by licensed electricians to ensure safety and

#### Q: What are the signs I need a house rewiring?

# Upcoming Events

[Aputure at BIRTV Beijing]
[BIRTV Beijing][29]
From illuminating light and shadow to defining the future. In 2025, we opened a new chapter in LED
point-source technology for film and television with our proprietary BLAIR and BLAIR-CG light
engines. In 2026, we will launch an update to our light engine technology, delivering optical
solutions that revolutionize performance at the source and eliminate the trade-off between
brightness and color. This year also marks a major upgrade to our intelligent control ecosystem and
the debut of an all-new product line. A spectacular showcase of light and shadow awaits, don't miss
it! We look forward to welcoming you!
8/19/2026
[Aputure at IBC Amsterdam]
[IBC Amsterdam][30]
Discover how Aputure's expanding ecosystem of professional lighting solutions is transforming
broadcast, live production, film, and studio workflows. Rather than showcasing individual products,
our booth demonstrates complete production environments, highlighting the seamless integration of
the STORM and NOVA series with Sidus Link Pro for intelligent, network-based lighting control.
Explore the Sidus Playground to experience advanced lighting workflows firsthand, see real-world
applications throughout the booth, and be among the first to discover exciting new additions to the
Aputure lineup that further expand our professional lighting ecosystem.

## [Lawn Grass Suppliers in Brisbane: Their Transportation and Installation Services][32]

[July 19, 2025June 25, 2025][33]

A lawn grass supplier in Brisbane is likely to comprehend the impact of weather on turf installation
in any location, regardless of whether it is residential or commercial. Choosing appropriate and
quality grass is among the many facets of the process, but it’s not the only important aspect.
Delivery and setup services from lawn grass suppliers significantly influence the quality of the
work. Such treatments could greatly affect the lifetime and overall function of the new grass being
placed. When laying turf in areas known for excessive humidity, weather fluctuations, and extreme
heat, it is very important to consider these elements.

 

## Providing Consistent, Well Run Delivery Services

Most Brisbane lawn suppliers are well-known for their services around the region. Delivery options
differ only according to the type of grass, distance, and order size. From modest yards to big
commercial sites, turf suppliers can handle a wide range of order sizes. Turf suppliers usually
harvest the grass on the same day it is delivered to ensure quality.

 

It is imperative to complete this step, as the grass will begin to degrade rapidly if it is exposed
to the sun or warmer temperatures. Turf suppliers recognise that expedited delivery choices can
shield the grass from drying out or overheating prior to installation. For this reason, most lawn
grass suppliers prefer to deliver the turf early in the morning.

 

Some suppliers will also offer clients same-day or next-day delivery options, which depend on the
availability at the time. Clients who live in more rural areas or hard-to-access parts of the region
may need to plan for delivery ahead of time or pay a delivery surcharge.

 

## Installation Services: Do-It-Yourself or Obtain Professional Assistance?

When it comes to installing turf, clients have a choice to either lay the turf themselves or hire a
professional turf supplier service. If you have landscaping experience, you could likely install the
turf yourself, especially if the site is smaller and less complex. However, turf installation does
require a lot of physical effort, mostly from having to roll out the turf pieces, which can be quite
heavy.

 

It also requires leveling the ground or soil before installing it, which can be strenuous on its
own. Some turf suppliers offer complete installation packages, which include the following:

 
* Application of fertiliser on soil.
* The preparation of the site includes tilling and levelling the soil.
* To ensure complete soil contact, they will roll and compact the turf.
* To ensure the turf fits at the designated site, they will lay and cut it.
* They provide aftercare and watering instructions to ensure longevity.

 

Having turf installed professionally ensures that it will be laid properly and quickly. This reduces
the risk of things such as uneven seams, gaps, and poor establishment of the roots.

 

## Site Positioning and Access

To ensure that delivery trucks can easily offload pallets closer to the installation site, lawn
grass suppliers will ask for clear access to the area. If access to the site is restricted, there
might be a need for additional handling by either the client or added labour services. Some turf
suppliers will provide mechanical forklifts to help with easier placement, especially for heavy
orders.

 

## Final Thoughts

When you decide to work with a [high-quality lawn grass supplier in Brisbane][34], it is important

## [Top Swimming Pool Design Trends Gold Coast 2025][35]

[July 16, 2025July 7, 2025][36]

A swimming pool is not just a place to cool your body from the extreme Gold Coast heat, but also a
perfect place where you can relax and unwind after a long and tiresome day or week. Swimming pools
form a great part of outdoor living in many Gold Coast homes, making it necessary to understand the
different types of pools that exist on the Gold Coast to make an informed decision.

Whether you are thinking of building a new pool or renovating the existing one, here are the top
trend designs for swimming pools on the Gold Coast.

## Exceptional swimming pool design trends in Gold COAS

### Smaller and Smarter Pools

Not everyone has space for a large pool. Many homeowners now choose plunge pools or small lap pools.
These pools save space and money as they require very little space and resources to build. They also
work well in city homes or smaller backyards and are highly recommended for homeowners with very
little space in their backyards.

### Natural-looking pools

Today, human activities have greatly transformed the environment, and it is hard to distinguish
between nature and man-made features. Therefore, many people want pools that look like part of
nature in 2025. This means using soft shapes, natural stone, and plants around the pool to achieve a
natural-looking finish. Some even choose a lagoon or rock pool style to blend in with their garden.

### Smart pool technology

Smart pools are becoming very popular on the Gold Coast. You can now control pool lights, heating,
and cleaning systems from your phone wherever you happen to be. Some systems even test water quality
and add chemicals automatically with absolutely no human intervention. This makes pool care easier
and faster.

standards.

Electricity keeps our homes running—but it can also pose serious risks if not handled properly.
Whether you're boiling the kettle, charging your phone, or rewiring a plug, knowing how to stay safe
is essential. This section offers clear, practical advice for every room and the people in your

## Hager Group, an independent family company shaping tomorrow’s electrical world.

Hager Group is a leading provider of solutions and services for electrical installations in
residential, commercial and industrial buildings. Our range of solutions and services extends from
energy distribution to cable management and from security systems to building automation. As an
independent family-owned and family-run company based in Blieskastel, Germany, we are one of the
industry’s innovation leaders. 13.000 employees generate sales of around 3,0 billion euros (2024).
Our components and solutions are produced at 23 locations around the globe and customers in 100
countries all over the world trust in them. We owe our success to their trust.
[About us][20]

## Hager Annual and Sustainability Report 2025/26

The world around us continues to evolve at an unprecedented pace. Rapid technological advances, the
energy transition, increasing sustainability expectations, and changing customer needs are reshaping
our industry and creating new opportunities for growth. Against this backdrop, our focus remains
clear: to build a resilient business that delivers lasting value while helping our customers
navigate the transformation of the energy landscape. 

This Annual Report reflects the progress we have made over the past year and the strategic direction
that continues to guide our journey. It tells the story of a company that is transforming with
purpose—combining operational excellence, innovation, and sustainability to strengthen our
competitive position and prepare for the future.

[Discover the full online version][21]
[annual_report_1024x1024]

## Our approach to sustainability

We want to shape tomorrow’s electrical world and make people’s life on our planet safer, cleaner and
more enjoyable through our actions and with our products. And, our sustainability policy is just one
of the ways to get there.
[Find out more][22]
[about hager group]

## Our values

Our company founders’ courageous entrepreneurial spirit, authenticity and integrity continue to
shape our future and make us who we are. Our values are at the heart of everything we do and form
the basis of our success.
[Find out more][23]
[hg_our_values]

energy transition, increasing sustainability expectations, and changing customer needs are reshaping
our industry and creating new opportunities for growth. Against this backdrop, our focus remains
clear: to build a resilient business that delivers lasting value while helping our customers
navigate the transformation of the energy landscape. 

This Annual Report reflects the progress we have made over the past year and the strategic direction
that continues to guide our journey. It tells the story of a company that is transforming with
purpose—combining operational excellence, innovation, and sustainability to strengthen our
competitive position and prepare for the future.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.
